maintenance_surface: Artifact-specific teacher-dashboard control pages may use maintenance PMs; the canonical Curriculum Control Panel does not expose a generic Maintenance tab.
portfolio_delivery_exception: Portfolio is a private Google Drive state/update workflow operated outside the generic initial-build menu.
